svg.aria-label: Animated pelican riding a bicycle from left to right
svg.title: Pelican riding a bicycle
svg.desc: A white pelican pedals a red bicycle facing right. Wheels and crank rotate, feet stay on pedals via two-bone leg IK, body bobs subtly, background scrolls left. Pause and Resume buttons freeze and restart all SMIL motion.

g.text: click Pause to freeze • Resume to restart • Space also toggles
